headline: High: n8n can write shared workspace state while Notion AI can ingest workspace content, creating default-path prompt-injection, leakage, and cascading-action risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: n8n can write files and orchestrate workflow outputs, while Notion AI reads workspace pages and knowledge-base content. That creates a plausible bridge where n8n-produced text is pasted or synced into Notion and then treated as trusted content. The pair lacks a documented provenance barrier, so uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF n8n workflow output is copied into a Notion page or database
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize or act on that page without provenance checks
mitigations: Add a visible provenance banner to n8n-generated content
Keep n8n outputs in a separate Notion workspace/page prefix
Require human review before Notion AI consumes workflow output
Use a short prompt template that labels imported text as untrusted
requires-engineering: add provenance metadata and filtering in the sync path

B_data_leakage.rationale: n8n has broad network egress and handles workflow data on the server filesystem; Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to Notion backends and downstream model providers. If the same sensitive material is moved from n8n into Notion pages, it can leave the original environment and be processed by third-party services. The shared-data path is plausible in default use, so medium fits.
conditions: IF n8n workflows place sensitive records into Notion pages or databases
IF those pages are then processed by Notion AI
mitigations: Restrict n8n workflows from sending secrets into Notion
Store sensitive fields in a separate system and link by ID only
Disable Notion AI on pages containing secrets
Review the exact data class before each sync
requires-engineering: implement field-level redaction before export

C_capability_conflict.rationale: n8n can write the server filesystem and execute commands, while Notion AI cannot write the host filesystem or spawn subprocesses. Their write surfaces do not overlap directly, so there is no strong same-resource conflict. Any conflict would require an external shared workspace or integration not shown here, so the safer choice is low rather than medium.
conditions: IF an external integration maps both agents onto the same mutable resource
IF n8n writes files that another system imports into Notion as authoritative state
mitigations: Keep n8n and Notion on separate storage targets
Avoid using shared mutable files as handoff artifacts
Use append-only logs instead of in-place edits
Review integration scopes for overlapping write access
requires-engineering: add locking or transactional handoff

D_cascading_error.rationale: n8n can generate workflow outputs and take actions through integrations, while Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content. If n8n-produced text is treated as authoritative inside Notion, downstream summaries or decisions can propagate errors without verification. Because both agents can influence work products, the cascade exists in default workflows and merits medium.
conditions: IF n8n output is inserted into Notion as source material
IF Notion AI answers or drafts actions from that material without human verification
mitigations: Require a human check before acting on Notion AI outputs
Mark n8n-generated pages as draft-only
Add a verification step that compares against source systems
Limit automation to read-only summaries
requires-engineering: add citation and validation gates between agents

E_compliance.rationale: n8n is self-hosted/open-source with server-side control, while Notion AI is closed-source and vendor-hosted with workspace content sent to Notion backends and downstream model providers. If regulated or residency-bound data moves from n8n into Notion, retention and jurisdiction controls may diverge. The profiles do not prove a specific violation, but the mismatch is plausible enough for medium.
conditions: IF regulated data is stored in n8n and then copied into Notion pages
IF the workspace data is subject to residency, retention, or deletion requirements
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion pages
Use Notion only for non-sensitive summaries
Document retention and deletion responsibilities
Confirm residency terms before syncing data
requires-engineering: enforce policy-based routing by data class
